# atproto_tangled_public_key (Resource)

Adds an SSH public key to the account. Knots read these records to authorize pushes.

Manages a `sh.tangled.publicKey` record.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "atproto_tangled_public_key" "laptop" {
  name = "laptop"
  key  = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Public key in OpenSSH `authorized_keys` format.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the key.

### Optional

- `created_at` (String) Record creation time. Defaults to the time the record is created.
- `rkey` (String) Record key. The PDS generates a TID when this is not set.

### Read-Only

- `cid` (String) CID of the current version of the record.
- `id` (String) AT URI of the record.
- `uri` (String) AT URI of the record.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
tofu import atproto_tangled_public_key.laptop 3lyvqfkzktj2s
```
